newsitem.title: USA: Macerich buys California and Montana malls.
newsitem.headline: Macerich buys California and Montana malls.

text.p: Macerich Co said Wednesday its subsidiaries have acquired one mall in Modesto, Calif.,, and one in Billings, Mont., for total consideration of about $118.2 million.

The purchase price included assumption of the existing first mortgages on the properties totaling $88.4 million and the assumption of other liabilities of $3 million, Macerich said. It said it paid the balance of $26.8 million in cash.

Vintage Faire Mall in California is a 1,052,196 square foot super regional mall, and the Rimrock Mall is a 583,112 square foot regional mail in Montana, Macerich said. Combined 1995 net operating income for the properties was $10.9 million, Macerich said.

The real estate investment trust said these property acquisitions are its eighth and ninth since it completed its initial public offering in March 1994. Macerich said it has ownership interests in 20 regional malls and three community centers representing 16.6 million square feet.
